{{Quote|If they killed you, Magar, I-I... I've already sworn to hunt down every pus-ridden Emperor lover on this planet...|Danla Zin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Magar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]] and the husband of [[Danla Zin]]. Along with some friends he had stolen Imperial uniforms and tried to infiltrate the Nebula Research Base in the [[Gorinth Canyon]]. Unfortunately for them, at the same time the base was being assaulted by the [[Voidhound]] and [[Corso Riggs]] who, upon seeing Imperials in uniform, opened fire and killed the men on the spot.

==Behind the Scene==
Magar appears as an "Imperial Officer" in the game. Only after the player kills him, does the dialogue reveal that it was merely a disguise.
